responsibility: Contains a historical, superseded appendix of GCC installation guidance retained for reference alongside the current installation manual. Rather than driving the main install workflow, it preserves older explanations of the generic GNU/Unix build procedure, the use of configure's build/host/target triples, required tool substitutions such as GNU assembler/linker, and large legacy lists of recognized CPU, company, system, and machine alias names under a "Configurations Supported by GCC" section.
